兜底失败则返回原始响应，交由上层处理 return resp return resp _pygen_requests.sessions.Session.request = _patched _pygen_install_requests_patch() # === PyGen 注入结束 === import os import json import time import re from datetime import datetime from urllib.parse import urljoin, urlparse from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright, TimeoutError as PlaywrightTimeoutError # ========================================== # 配置区域 # ========================================== # 目标 URL BASE_URL = "https://www.centralbank.org.bz/publications-search" # 爬取数量限制 (用户要求前5条，可根据需要修改) MAX_ITEMS = 5 # 辅助函数 # ========================================== def ensure_dir(path): if not os.path.exists(path): os.makedirs(path) def clean_html_content(html_content, base_url): """ 清洗 HTML 内容： 1. 将相对路径图片/链接转换为绝对路径 2. 移除无用标签（可选） """ if not html_content: return "" # 简单使用正则替换相对路径 (避免引入 BeautifulSoup 依赖，保持脚本独立性，或者使用简单的字符串替换) # 但为了稳健性，这里使用简单的正则处理 src="..." 和 href="..." def replace_url(match): attr = match.group(1) # src or href quote = match.group(2) # " or ' link = match.group(3) # the url if link.startswith('http') or link.startswith('data:') or link.startswith('#'): return match.group(0) absolute_link = urljoin(base_url, link) return f'{attr}={quote}{absolute_link}{quote}' # 替换 img src html_content = re.sub(r'(src)=("|\')([^"\']+)("|\')', replace_url, html_content, flags=re.IGNORECASE) # 替换 a href html_content = re.sub(r'(href)=("|\')([^"\']+)("|\')', replace_url, html_content, flags=re.IGNORECASE) return html_content def parse_custom_date(date_str): """ 解析网站特定的日期格式，例如 "23 February 2026" """ if not date_str: return "" date_str = date_str.strip() formats = [ "%d %B %Y", # 23 February 2026 "%B %d, %Y", # February 23, 2026 "%Y-%m-%d", # 2026-02-23 "%d/%m/%Y" # 23/02/2026 ] for fmt in formats: try: dt = datetime.strptime(date_str, fmt) return dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d") except ValueError: continue # 如果都解析失败，尝试提取 YYYY-MM-DD 模式 match = re.search(r'(\d{4})[-/](\d{1,2})[-/](\d{1,2})', date_str) if match: return f"{match.group(1)}-{match.group(2).zfill(2)}-{match.group(3).zfill(2)}" return date_str # 返回原字符串作为兜底 def is_file_url(url): """判断是否为文件链接""" if not url: return False path = urlparse(url).path.lower() extensions = ['.pdf', '.doc', '.docx', '.xls', '.xlsx', '.zip', '.rar'] return any(path.endswith(ext) for ext in extensions) # 简单的有效性检查 break if content_html: article_data["content"] = clean_html_content(content_html, url) else: print("警告: 未找到有效正文内容") except Exception as e: print(f"详情页抓取错误: {e}") finally: page.close() return article_data def crawl_news(): """ 主爬虫函数 """ results = [] with sync_playwright() as p: #
